metrics.name: Exercise success rate
metrics.construct: Percentage of planned attempts that produce a complete exercise, pass the independent Artemis evaluation, and stay within budget.
metrics.population: All planned attempts in the frozen experiment design
metrics.denominator: All planned attempts; started- and completed-attempt sensitivities are reported separately
metrics.status_mapping: strict success=1; every other planned outcome=0
metrics.implementation: exgen evaluation protocol v1 with pinned Artemis verifier identity
metrics.evidence: Artemis verification report, evaluator journal, and generation ledger

validation.method: Contract fixtures plus a frozen expert-reviewed acceptance suite

metrics.limitations: Measures conformance to the pinned Artemis target and suite, not all dimensions of pedagogical quality

metrics.name: Artemis platform checks
metrics.construct: Whether the generated exercise passes every required check in the fixed Artemis verification profile.
metrics.denominator: Candidates with a quality verdict; infrastructure failures remain missing
metrics.status_mapping: canonical verifier pass=true; verifier rejection=false; verifier infrastructure error=missing
metrics.implementation: Pinned Artemis verifier revision and suite digest recorded in each response
metrics.evidence: Structured verifier report and allowlisted evidence references

validation.method: Calibration against expert-reviewed valid and invalid exercises before a confirmatory run

metrics.limitations: A passing technical exercise may still require separate human evaluation of pedagogical quality
